d.ko: DreadOut is a third person supernatural horror game where you play as Linda, a high school student trapped in an old abandoned town.  Equipped with her trusty smart-phone, she will battle against terrifying encounters and solve mysterious puzzles which will ultimately determine her fate.

d.zh: 《小镇惊魂》是一款第三人称超自然恐怖游戏。你扮演琳达，一名被困在废弃古镇里的女高中生。带着信赖的智能手机，她将与可怕的遭遇周旋，解开决定自己命运的谜题。
